capabilities: Convert numeric citations into unique hex footnote IDs vault-wide
Parse pasted LLM citation output into a canonical footnote format
Extract citation metadata from highlighted URLs
Promote citations to canonical source files with captured PDFs and text
Enrich citation files with authors, dates, and publisher metadata after review
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later and is desktop only; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is one plugin in the author's Content Farm suite (Perplexed, Metafetch, Image Gin), which the README recommends installing separately.
intentEvidence: Converts numeric citations [1] into unique hex codes [^a1b2c3]
problem: Obsidian footnotes are renumbered by order of appearance and offer no vault-wide way to track, dedupe, enrich, or store citations with their sources.

relations.evidence: Automatically creates citation files in a dedicated folder for Dataview/Bases queries
formatted citations from URLs use Jina.ai Reader API

summary: Citation manager that converts numeric citations into stable hex footnotes, logs sources to files for Bases/Dataview, and parses pasted LLM citations.
